# Exterior Door Trim Moulding Fitment Variations

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Check for pre-existing door holes and compare your specific year against known variations to determine if drilling is necessary. [t281]

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that 'Off Road' (OR) and 'Pro-4X' trims frequently have holes, while other trims often do not. [t281]
- Be aware of the 2015 S trim anomaly where some units had holes despite lacking them on others. [t281]
